apps.name: RA Companion
apps.subtitle: Companion app for RetroAchievements
apps.localizedDescription:
Track your RetroAchievements progress directly from your iPhone.

Features:
• Live progression tracking
• Recent unlocks and badges
• Game library overview

versions.localizedDescription:
Translation services: DeepL and LibreTranslate (key / server in the settings) with a preferred service, the others take over if one fails. Windows: global refresh shortcut that works while an emulator has the focus (Ctrl+Alt+R by default), windows open on the screen of the app.

Full Changelog:
https://github.com/PsickOSSH/RA-Companion/compare/v1.6...v1.7

Refresh interval down to 5 s, configurable refresh shortcut on Windows (F1 by default), automatic retries on temporary API errors, readable error messages on Windows.

Full Changelog:
https://github.com/PsickOSSH/RA-Companion/compare/v1.5...v1.6

In-app unlock banner on iOS and Android: badge, description, points, stacking, auto height.

Full Changelog:
https://github.com/PsickOSSH/RA-Companion/compare/v1.3...v1.5
